connector.name: LeakRank Guard
connector.registryDescription: Scans code changes for leaked secrets and insecure config, with actionable fixes for AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package leakrank-guard. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the prototeemo account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LEAKRANK_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Normally the key is stored on this machine by `npx leakrank-guard login` (OS keychain, or ~/.config/leakrank/config.json at mode 0600), so no environment variable is needed. Set this only for CI or headless use.
